global_rule: A missing source hit is never a negative signal unless both entity identity and source coverage are proven for the full historical query scope.

sources.publication_clock: Official CIPO Trademarks Journal publication date for the Advertised Applications section.
sources.coverage_rule: All 1,221 official English Journal issues from 2000-01-05 through 2023-05-31 are fetched and their Advertised Applications sections parsed. Non-hits become absence only for reviewed current legal aliases and source-backed historical legal-name aliases, and only because every issue completed with zero unresolved alias occurrences.
sources.identity_rule: Requires foreign_signal_identity_eligible=true. Exact reviewed current aliases plus primary-source-backed historical legal names only; no fuzzy/group inference.
sources.signal_definition: At least one application in the official CIPO Trademarks Journal Advertised Applications section before the event-time cutoff where the publication-time applicant matches a reviewed current or source-backed historical legal alias.

sources.coverage_rule: Current Corporations Canada detail proves legal events, but the project has not established a strict historical public-availability clock for those events. Current observations cannot be backdated.
CORDIS bulk data contains project/content-update dates but no proven first-publication timestamp for historical leakage control in the current implementation.

Each reviewed legal-entity alias is queried across the official TED Search API from 2012-01-01 through the Backtest 001 maximum cutoff. The server-side winner-name query is treated only as a candidate-retrieval superset; every returned winner-name is client-side normalized and exact-postfiltered to the reviewed alias. Absence is allowed only after complete retrieval of every alias query and zero exact postfilter matches before the cutoff.
sources.identity_rule: Requires foreign_signal_identity_eligible=true. Reviewed exact aliases only; server-side candidate matches that do not exactly normalize to the reviewed alias are discarded.
sources.signal_definition: At least one TED award notice published on or after 2012-01-01 and before the event-time cutoff where a returned winner-name exactly normalizes to a reviewed foreign legal-entity alias.
sources.candidate_query_semantics: winner-name field query is a retrieval superset, not trusted as exact legal-name equality; exactness is enforced after retrieval.

sources.publication_clock: For a base award notice, publicationDate. For an amended row, use the later of publicationDate and amendmentDate so amended supplier/content fields are not backdated.
sources.coverage_rule: Exact reviewed foreign legal-entity aliases are scanned against supplierLegalName across the authoritative federal award-notice corpus from 2012-02-03 onward: legacy 2012-to-2022-08, an overlapping 2022-2023 bridge file, and the complete 2022-08-08-onward CanadaBuys file. Absence applies only to this exact-alias federal-award signal since 2012, not to procurement relationships under other legal names or outside this federal corpus.
sources.identity_rule: Requires foreign_signal_identity_eligible=true. Exact reviewed aliases only; no fuzzy/group inference.
sources.signal_definition: At least one federal CanadaBuys award-notice row on or after 2012-02-03 and before the event-time cutoff where supplierLegalName exactly normalizes to a reviewed foreign legal-entity alias.
